body:
Different local providers change both the paid child profile and the helper
inventory in the shared owner pool. The fixed-U8 T37 ceiling does not cover
this coupling. This package proves that no mixture of the complete pinned
catalogue can beat the U8/T37 complex moment under the retained data capacities
and whole-helper contract.

The catalogue contains every provider in the 35 top-level
`research/*/data/SPEC*.json` files at
`8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20`: 71 source records and 25 distinct
cost interfaces. The common dual accounts for both changed total helper width
and changed signed packing credit. It permits arbitrary positive replica
counts, real call counts, and a shared pool with all time and matching
restrictions removed. Every alternative interface has a strictly positive
reduced cost throughout `0 < b <= 1/500`.

This is a catalogue-scoped negative result. There is no new kappa, local
factory, owner witness, finite invoice, or cold replay. The selected frontier
and `upstream/` are unchanged. The signed bin prices, fixed-U8 support, and
T37 witness are credited to their source work. The new part is the complete
mixed-inventory separation. `NOTICE.md` also credits the concurrent T37,
uniform-support, integrality, U10, leaver, and restoration-deferral work.

The controls explicitly reject the favorable U10, R489, and R480 cost vectors
outside the base catalogue. New providers, new data capacities, helper
migration, split helpers, and changed restoration contracts need separate
claims. Native and asymptotic obligations remain conditional.

Validation:

- Two exact rational interval engines check all 1,163 bin patterns, 92
  maximum-price cases, all 25 provider penalties, the root signs, the PR589
  surcharge, and all 47 outer constraints.
- A separately written integer-form checker passes under `python -I -O`.
  It does not import the primary checker.
- Fourteen controls pass, including missing records, source drift, wrong
  aliases, changed profiles, favorable new providers, and later source growth.
- A complete `git ls-tree` and `git show` audit checks the base catalogue.
  Default replay uses the frozen list; new records are reported separately.
- All three saved receipts reproduce byte for byte. The selected-record
  check and `git diff --check` pass. The coordinator also reviewed the proof
  and reran the primary, independent, and control checks.

Run from the repository root with a fresh output filename:

```sh
python3 -B research/heterogeneous-owner-assembly/verify.py \
  --audit-base-tree --out /tmp/heterogeneous-owner-bound.json
```

Expected status: `PASS_HETEROGENEOUS_OWNER_CATALOGUE_BOUND`, with 71 records,
25 interfaces, and the existing grid ceiling `0.001661960547713947`.

Prepared for Ali Romman (@aliromman) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
Apache-2.0. No independent human review or full formal verification is claimed.
